items.title: How the Data Center Backlash Could Play Into the Hands of Big Tech
items.analytical_takeaway: Post-midterm slowdown in new data-center builds creates scarcity value for existing capacity. Positive for Amazon and Microsoft (+6% post-election) and chipmaker bonds; negative for chipmaker equities and Texas-heavy pipelines.

items.title: Early Thoughts On Blue Wave Implications On DC & Power Funding
items.source_name: J.P. Morgan North America Credit Research
items.analytical_takeaway: Democratic governor wins in TX, GA, NM, NV, OH and 42/45 local anti-DC ballot measures threaten 2028+ energizations. ~27% of HY project-finance MW and ~78% of public HY DC builder pipelines (incl. Galaxy) sit in Texas.

items.title: The Tangled Web of AI Bets Is Reason to Fear Tech Stocks
items.analytical_takeaway: NVIDIA, AMD, and Broadcom acted as $5B cornerstone investors in Meta's $25B stock sale (inverted vendor financing). CoreWeave 2031 9% bonds trade >1,000 bps over Treasuries; NVIDIA carries a $105B Ohio campus backstop for OpenAI/SB Energy.

items.title: Investors Are Hedging Against the Risks of the AI Boom
items.analytical_takeaway: Rising demand for options, credit-default swaps, and new compute-price derivatives signals growing institutional hedging against an AI unwind.

items.title: Is AI Running Out of Money to Borrow? Anthropic's $63B Broadcom Chip Debt Deal
items.analytical_takeaway: Broadcom structured a $63B SPV chip-financing package ($40B banks + $23B incl. Blackstone) with Broadcom guarantees and parallel lending revealed in Anthropic's S-1, exposing Broadcom's IG balance sheet to Anthropic default risk.
